The '''Collette [[system]]''' contains a solitary red main sequence [[star]], nine [[world|major bodies]] (of which four are [[gas giant]]s), numerous [[asteroid|minor bodies]], and one [[planetoid belt]]. 
* The [[mainworld]] in this [[star system]] is the inner planet, named [[Collette (world)|'''Collette''']].
* [[Halthome (world)|Halthome]] is the outer [[satellite]] of Yoshua, a [[large gas giant]] lying in orbit 1.

== Description ([[Specifications]]) ==
The major settlements within the [[system]] are located on [[Collette (world)|Collette]], the [[mainworld]], and on [[Halthome (world)|Halthome]], the outer moon of Yoshua.
* [[Collette (world)|Collette]] is the [[subsector]] [[capital]].
* It is the location of a [[Naval Base]].
* It is the site of a [[Scout Base]].

== History & Background ([[Dossier]]) ==
During the [[Long Night]] Collette was named ''Madaa''.

The [[planetoid belt]] and the [[Gas Giant]]s within the [[system]] are named for ancient [[Terra]]n religious figures. Smaller rocky worlds are named for individuals associated with the pre-[[Interstellar Wars]] era [[Terra]]n literary figure Collette.
